description: Dynamic step-up logging for ASP.NET Core with Serilog - automatically increase log verbosity when errors occur, with minimal performance overhead. Includes request body capture, sensitive data redaction, and OpenTelemetry metrics.
releaseNotes: v6.3.2 - Request summary fields on the Text console line: ConsoleTextProperties defaults to Jti, Method, Path, StatusCode and ElapsedMs, so a request summary line carries them as Key=value next to Message. A configured list still replaces the default. JSON console, OTLP and file are unchanged. See CHANGELOG.md. v6.3.1 - Text console line as logfmt: every item of the Text console line is written as Key=value (Timestamp, Level, TraceId or traceparent, SourceContext, Message, then ConsoleTextProperties, then Exception on the same line); values with a space, =, quote, backslash or control character are double-quoted and escaped. JSON console, OTLP and file are unchanged. See CHANGELOG.md. v6.3.0 - Request summary direction, detail and outbound summary (#91), additional exclude paths (#90): AdditionalExcludePaths (default none) is appended to the effective ExcludePaths and keeps the built-in defaults. Every request summary carries Direction (Inbound or Outbound), ClientKind from the User-Agent and new non-sensitive fields (Route, Aborted, ClientId; in Full also Protocol, Scheme, Host, content lengths, auth state and endpoint name). RequestSummaryDetail (Full or Compact, default Full) selects the fields. AlwaysLogOutboundRequestSummary (default false) writes one summary per IHttpClientFactory call. Changed: the summary template is now {Direction} {Method} {Path} {StatusCode} {ElapsedMs} ms {ClientKind} {UserAgent}, and UserAgent is always present, (none) when missing. See CHANGELOG.md. v6.2.0 - Redaction exemptions and a keyed console trace id (#87): RedactionExemptProperties (default empty) lists property names, such as Jti, whose values are never passed through RedactionRegexes, in the RedactLogEventProperties sweep and for Jti on the request summary and completion event; request inputs are always redacted. ConsoleTraceFormat (default TraceId) writes the Text console trace id as TraceId=<hex> or as a W3C traceparent=. Changed: the Text console line no longer writes the trace id as a bare token. See CHANGELOG.md. v6.1.0 - Audit rejection observer (#71): optional IAuditRejectionObserver singletons are told the status and top-level problem+json code of each record the endpoint rejects on its own, after it is dead-lettered, so a consumer can refresh its sealing key on 422 sealing.unknown_key; inform only, bounded by DeliveryTimeout, nothing changes when none is registered. See CHANGELOG.md. v6.0.0 - Configuration with production defaults. Breaking: DurationSeconds defaults to 3 instead of 180 (set 180 to keep the previous step-up window), OTLP export is on only when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set (set EnableOtlpExporter true for a collector at the default localhost without the variable), and a configured NeverStepUpCategories list replaces the default, with [] clearing it. Startup report: one Information line with the effective configuration and a Warning for each unknown key under SerilogStepUp and each option with no effect. Options validation names each failing key and its value and checks RedactionRegexes. The README starts with what to set and what is on by default. See CHANGELOG.md and MIGRATION.md. v5.4.0 - Framework category defaults: FrameworkCategoryDefaults (default Recommended) floors ASP.NET Core hosting, routing, MVC, HTTP results, static files, HttpClient, Polly, EF Core command and Npgsql command categories at Warning and keeps them out of the pre-error buffer, so a failing request exports the application events and the summary; CategoryFloors entries override the defaults and None restores the previous behaviour. ConsoleFormat Text (default Json) writes the console as one readable line per event with the trace id and the ConsoleTextProperties (default Jti); OTLP and file stay structured. Fixes: EnableOtlpExporter=false set in code also skips the OpenTelemetry SDK exporter, an OpenTelemetry 1.15 registration made before AddStepUpLogging is detected again, and level options accept level names only. See CHANGELOG.md. v5.3.0 - Pre-error buffer exclude categories (#79): PreErrorBufferExcludeCategories (default empty) keeps the listed SourceContext prefixes' events below Warning out of the pre-error buffer, so an Error flush does not export them; other categories still flush and Diagnostic mode is unaffected. See CHANGELOG.md. v5.2.0 - Stalled drain made visible (#71): audit_spool_oldest_age_seconds gauge, opt-in health signal (EncryptedSpoolOptions.OldestRecordMaxAge, OldestRecordStatus), a reason tag on audit_spool_dead_lettered_total, and the documented answer for an unknown key (503 while keys load, 422 when gone). See CHANGELOG.md. v5.1.0 - Encrypted spool throughput (#69): opt-in batched delivery (EncryptedSpoolOptions.DeliveryBatchSize, POST {EndpointBaseUrl}/audit/batch; default 1 keeps the wire unchanged); concurrent durable writes no longer queue behind one gate, the cap still holds; a full spool refuses from its tally and re-checks the disk at most once per SpoolFullRecheckInterval instead of scanning the directory on every write; dropped records are logged at Critical at a bounded rate. See CHANGELOG.md.
